headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Payment of Interest on Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified to NSE that it has made timely payment of interest on its publicly issued, listed Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures, in compliance with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulation 57.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited filed a formal intimation with NSE under SEBI LODR Regulation 57, certifying that the Company has discharged its interest payment obligations on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures, which were issued via public issue and listed on the stock exchange. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing required of listed debt issuers to keep the exchange and market participants informed of debt servicing status. The filing does not disclose specific coupon amount, maturity date, or issue size; it is a categorical certification of performance against the debt instrument's payment schedule.
